_readme: Retrieval ground truth. Write these against YOUR sandbox, not from imagination.
Target 25+ cases. The categories below are not optional decoration — an 80%
aggregate can be 100% on prose and 20% on identifier lookups, and only the
identifier  - contains a ticket key, vendor name, or exact term (INS-101, Acme)
semantic    - paraphrase; the target page never uses the query's words
negative    - a question the corpus genuinely cannot answer. The system must
retrieve nothing relevant rather than confidently citing the
nearest page. Skipping these is how you ship a system that
ambiguous   - matches several pages; all valid targets go in relevant_page_ids
Ground truth is PAGE ids, not chunk ids — chunk boundaries move every time you
touch the chunker, and an eval set that breaks on every tweak stops being run.

cases.question: What is blocking INS-101?
cases.note: Embeddings are weak on exact keys; this case exists to prove BM25 is carrying its half.

cases.question: Why did we decide to terminate TLS at the gateway?
cases.note: The ADR never uses the word 'why'.

cases.question: Who has to sign off before the claims integration goes live?
cases.note: Two valid sources. Onboarding guide mentions 'sign off' in an unrelated sense.

cases.question: What is our parental leave policy?
cases.note: Not in the ARCH space. System must decline, not cite the nearest HR-ish page.

cases.question: What changed in the vendor contract most recently?
